input_data: How do I request a replacement debit card?
ground_truth: Lock the card and report it in the mobile app under Manage Cards → Report Lost or Stolen. A replacement debit card arrives in 2–5 business days; expedited shipping is available for a fee.

input_data: How long after opening an account will I receive my debit card?
ground_truth: After approval, your debit card is mailed within 5–7 business days.

input_data: Where can I request an additional credit card?
ground_truth: Log in to the mobile app and go to Cards → Request Additional Card, complete the form, and submit.

input_data: How do I activate my new credit card?
ground_truth: Activate instantly in the mobile app or by calling the number on the card sticker.

input_data: How do I change my card PIN?
ground_truth: Change your PIN at an ATM or in the mobile app under Manage PIN.

input_data: Why was my card declined?
ground_truth: Declines may be caused by exceeding daily limits, entering an incorrect PIN, insufficient funds, or suspected fraud.

input_data: How can I avoid card declines while traveling internationally?
ground_truth: Add a travel notice under Card Settings before you travel. Foreign transactions may incur a 3% fee unless your card benefits waive it.

input_data: Do premium cards waive foreign transaction fees?
ground_truth: Some premium cards waive the 3% foreign transaction fee; check your card’s benefits guide.

input_data: What is the minimum opening deposit for a checking account?
ground_truth: Most checking accounts require a minimum opening deposit of $25 to $100.

input_data: Which features come with checking accounts?
ground_truth: Checking includes online bill pay, mobile check deposit, paperless statements, and access to over 15,000 fee‑free ATMs.

input_data: What do savings accounts earn and how is interest paid?
ground_truth: Savings accounts earn interest calculated daily and paid monthly. Rates vary by balance tier.

input_data: What documents are required to open an account?
ground_truth: Provide a government‑issued photo ID, Social Security Number, and proof of address. Non‑residents need valid visa and immigration documentation.

input_data: Can I open an account online and how long does it take?
ground_truth: Yes. Open an account online by selecting Open an Account, uploading your photo ID, and completing an e‑signature. The process takes 5–10 minutes.

input_data: How do I close my account?
ground_truth: Ensure all transactions are settled and the balance is zero, then request closure online or at a branch. You will receive a confirmation email.

input_data: How do I switch to paperless statements?
ground_truth: Enable paperless delivery in Documents & Settings. You’ll receive an email when a new monthly statement is ready.

input_data: When are monthly statements generated?
ground_truth: Monthly statements are generated on the last business day of each month and can be downloaded as PDFs.

input_data: How do I deposit a check on mobile and when will funds be available?
ground_truth: Use Deposit Check in the mobile app to photograph the front and back. Funds are usually available the next business day; the first $225 is available immediately and the remainder clears within two business days.

input_data: What is overdraft protection and how do I enable it?
ground_truth: Link a savings account or credit card to automatically cover overdrafts. A small transfer fee may apply.

input_data: How do I pay bills online?
ground_truth: Use Bill Pay to add a payee and schedule one‑time or recurring payments in online or mobile banking.

input_data: Can I transfer money to another bank and how long does it take?
ground_truth: Yes. Link your external account; transfers complete in 1–3 business days after micro‑deposit verification.

input_data: Are Zelle transfers instant?
ground_truth: Eligible Zelle transfers between U.S. accounts typically complete within minutes.

input_data: How do I send an international wire and what are the fees?
ground_truth: Submit an international wire in online banking using the recipient’s SWIFT/BIC. Funds typically arrive in 2–3 business days and fees are $30–$45.

input_data: What are domestic wire requirements and timing?
ground_truth: Domestic wires can be sent during business hours through online banking and typically post the same business day depending on the receiving bank.

input_data: What is the ATM daily withdrawal limit?
ground_truth: You can withdraw up to $1,000 per day from ATMs, depending on account type.

input_data: How do I view my credit score?
ground_truth: View your FICO score for free in online banking; it updates monthly and does not affect your credit.

input_data: What rewards do credit cards offer?
ground_truth: Earn 1.5% cash back on purchases redeemable for travel, statement credits, or gift cards.

input_data: How are APRs determined for credit products?
ground_truth: APR varies by credit profile and product. See your cardholder or loan agreement for specific rates.

input_data: How does the bank monitor for fraud?
ground_truth: Transactions are monitored 24/7 for unusual activity. Suspicious activity may trigger alerts or a temporary block until confirmed.

input_data: How do I dispute an unauthorized transaction and how long does it take?
ground_truth: Open the transaction in the app and select Report an Issue. Investigations usually complete within 10 business days.

input_data: What should I do if I forget my password or get locked out?
ground_truth: Use Forgot Password to verify via SMS or email and reset. After five failed login attempts the account locks for security.

input_data: What are customer support hours and accessibility options?
ground_truth: Support is available 24/7 by phone or chat. Branches operate Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m.–1 p.m. Accessibility options include screen‑reader support and large text modes.

input_data: How does the bank protect my data and how can I manage privacy preferences?
ground_truth: Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest in compliance with the Gramm‑Leach‑Bliley Act. You can opt out of marketing and third‑party sharing in Privacy Settings.

input_data: Where can I find nearby branches and ATMs?
ground_truth: Use the Find Us feature in the mobile app to locate nearby branches and ATMs using GPS.

input_data: Are safe deposit boxes available?
ground_truth: Yes. Safe deposit boxes are available at select branches with annual rental fees and multiple sizes.

input_data: Does the bank offer currency exchange?
ground_truth: Yes. Currency exchange for major currencies is available at select branches with daily updated rates and a service fee.

input_data: Request a debit card replacement (variant phrasing)
ground_truth: Report a lost or stolen debit card in the app under Manage Cards. Replacement delivery: 2–5 business days; expedited shipping offered.

input_data: Request an additional card (variant)
ground_truth: In the mobile app, navigate to Cards → Request Additional Card and submit the form to add a new card.

input_data: Paperless statements (variant)
ground_truth: Turn on paperless statements in Documents & Settings to receive email notifications when new statements are posted.

input_data: Mobile check deposit availability (variant)
ground_truth: Deposited checks are typically available next business day; $225 available immediately and the rest within two business days.
